# Clipper2 geometry dependency

Pinned to the upstream tag `Clipper2_2.0.1` at https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2/tree/Clipper2_2.0.1/CSharp/Clipper2Lib.

The C# source is unmodified and licensed under the included Boost Software License 1.0. BOM uses polygon union, subtraction and constrained triangulation. This dependency is independent of the previous Bomb game implementation; no game code from that repository is included in this project.
